visible.author: cbowers
visible.title: Great look, not the best fit or hardware
visible.body: This intake seems to perform as intended. Definitely gives your truck that "intake" throatyness. Instructions are decent, good quality photos so you can see the details being referenced. Good quality filter. The cons: the filter fell off its clamp point a couple times for a couple reasons; there is no "lip" on the mount or the filter opening to seat the filter in place. The clamps are not strong enough to handle the kind of tightening I applied and stripped. I dont like to take chances and suck up something if a connections comes loose. The air box for the filter is a PITA to get right with one person and the instructions do not give enough detail on where to mount. Lastly, the the breather hose to the valve cover is a flimsy hose. It kinks easily, and does not utilize factory type hose connectors, instead, more band clamps. Although this seems like a negative review, it is not. This is a very nice intake for your truck at a great value.
visible.product: RedRock Cold Air Intake; Polished (19-26 5.3L, 6.2L Silverado 1500)
